architecture: Package W304/E9 + three independent W128/D2 decoders; disjoint fixed masks24 + frozen RQ/frame/Motion tokenizer
precision: FP32 deterministic algorithms; TF32 off; FLA float32 IEEE; Top8/32 sparse experts
ensemble: mean final fine predictions; no GT history
training_loss: mean of three independent member losses for both A and ordinal; not ensemble loss
gradient_ratio: fixed Train panel median weighted auxiliary/main all-trainable gradient L2 ratio=.075; calibrated once per phase, before clipping

phase1.selection: minimum complete regular Val A over6epochs
phase1.scheduler: negative complete regular Val exact Kendall tau-b

optimizer: AdamW LR3e-4 WD1e-4 betas(.9,.999) eps1e-8 clip1; Plateau factor.5 patience2 cooldown1 minLR1e-5
sampling: seed42; stage/person/hand uniform then recording weighted by legal integer starts, replacement; fixed16-window recording blocks; gain U(.8,1.25),5%one-channel dropout,Gaussian noise std.02 after norm
Val: fixed gap-contained2s windows; ensemble at common55; full native statistics/force bins/person/stage/cumulativebest, no model Test
upstream_tokenizer: Train-only frame EMA128x8x2/finger LeakyReLU MLP, then autonomous Motion width128; each Val normalized MAE min/max50/pat10
checkpoint: full model/Adam/scheduler/8RNG/cursor/history/best every16updates and safe stop; independent weight snapshot each completed epoch
reader: local-only legacy processed NPY pair/processedTask43MCAP/filteredTask83NPZ; LUT once before interpolation; gen3identity; no S3 fallback
historical_checkpoint_restore: not admitted in this portable release; use init_run and requalify
